topic: What zero WPS rejections in twelve months actually means for a 200-person business
format: Lead with a specific customer outcome — time saved, errors eliminated, hours recovered — then describe what changed
post:
A full year without a single WPS rejection is possible even for a 200-person payroll.

No bounced payroll. No Ministry of Labour flags. No one calling the bank in a panic at 6pm on payday.

The old way needed three people, two days, and a WhatsApp thread everyone dreaded. Deadlines slipped. Errors crept in. One rejection would spiral into a week of damage control.

Direct bank integration changes the sequence entirely. Compliance checks run before submission, not after. The finance team stops treating the last Thursday of the month like a fire drill.

This is what it actually looks like — no manual uploads, no crossed fingers, no "did it go through?" at 11pm.
